# Copilot / AI contributor guide

- **Stack & entry points**: Next.js 15 (app router) with React 19. Layout at [src/app/layout.tsx](src/app/layout.tsx); main single-page sections rendered in [src/app/page.tsx](src/app/page.tsx) with anchors `home`, `exp`, `qual`, `skills`, `about` for navbar highlighting.
- **Dev workflow**: Run `pnpm dev` (or `npm run dev`) to start turbopack; `pnpm build` uses turbopack too. No tests or lint scripts defined. Keep components `use client` when they touch browser APIs, GSAP, or framer-motion.
- **Styling**: Tailwind v4 via `@import "tailwindcss"` in [src/app/globals.css](src/app/globals.css). Theme tokens (colors, radii, fonts) defined inline with `@theme`; body background is a radial gradient. Prefer utility classes; add global styles in `globals.css` only when needed.
- **Fonts**: Geist, Geist Mono, DotGothic16, Manrope loaded with `next/font` in [src/app/layout.tsx](src/app/layout.tsx); body applies the font CSS variables—reuse those tokens instead of manual `font-family` strings.
- **Navigation**: Sticky navbar in [src/components/Globals/Navbar/index.tsx](src/components/Globals/Navbar/index.tsx) drives smooth scroll + history hash updates. When adding sections, set the `id` to one of the tracked keys or update the `sections` array to keep highlighting working.
- **Hero/home**: [src/features/Home/Homepage.tsx](src/features/Home/Homepage.tsx) renders the intro, avatar image (`/public/profile.png`), social icons (lucide), and hover tooltip wrapper [src/shared/components/WithTooltip.tsx](src/shared/components/WithTooltip.tsx). Text scrambling uses `DecryptedText`—prefer this for animated titles.
- **Experience**: [src/features/Experience/ExperiencePage.tsx](src/features/Experience/ExperiencePage.tsx) wraps `CurvedLoop` marquee + [src/features/Experience/TimelineComponent.tsx](src/features/Experience/TimelineComponent.tsx) timeline built with `react-vertical-timeline-component`. Keep timeline items declarative; duplicated sample entries can be collapsed into mapped data when extending.
- **Skills**: [src/features/Skills/SkillsPage.tsx](src/features/Skills/SkillsPage.tsx) is a grid of motion-driven badges using `framer-motion`; currently placeholder icons (`Logo_C_sharp.svg`). Follow the grid structure and hover animation if adding categories.
- **Animation utilities**: 
  - Text splitting/scroll reveal via typed GSAP helper [src/components/ReactBits/SplitText.tsx](src/components/ReactBits/SplitText.tsx) (preferred over legacy JS version [src/components/SplitText.jsx](src/components/SplitText.jsx)). Requires `use client` and registers GSAP plugins; ensure fonts are loaded before animating.
  - Typing effect in [src/components/TextType.tsx](src/components/TextType.tsx) supports variable speeds, cursor behaviors, looping, and intersection-based start.
  - Scramble/reveal text in [src/components/DecryptedText.tsx](src/components/DecryptedText.tsx) can trigger on hover or when in view; respects `sequential` and `revealDirection` options.
  - Curved marquee text in [src/components/CurvedLoop.jsx](src/components/CurvedLoop.jsx) with styles in [src/components/CurvedLoop.css](src/components/CurvedLoop.css); use `interactive={false}` for decorative loops or enable drag-to-spin behavior.
  - Simple marquee carousel in [src/features/Home/MarqueeItem.tsx](src/features/Home/MarqueeItem.tsx) uses `framer-motion` linear repeats; pass two copies of the image array to avoid gaps.
- **UI primitives**: Button + variants in [src/components/ui/button.tsx](src/components/ui/button.tsx) built with `class-variance-authority`; tooltips in [src/components/ui/tooltip.tsx](src/components/ui/tooltip.tsx) wrap Radix and are consumed via `WithTooltip`. Use `cn` helper from [src/lib/utils.ts](src/lib/utils.ts) for class merging.
- **State/hooks**: `useHash` hook in [src/Customhooks/useHash.tsx](src/Customhooks/useHash.tsx) reads/removes URL hash without scroll; useful if deep-linking sections.
- **Images/assets**: Static assets live under `/public`; use `next/image` where possible (see hero avatar) for optimization.
- **Conventions**: Prefer TypeScript components under `src`; avoid creating new JS duplicates. Keep components colocated under `features/<Area>` for page sections and `components/` for reusable primitives/effects. Maintain anchor IDs to keep navbar syncing. Keep gradient/styling tokens centralized in `globals.css`.
- **Adding animations safely**: Register GSAP plugins once per component, clean up ScrollTriggers on unmount, and guard DOM access with client components. When using motion (from `framer-motion` or `motion/react`), keep animations lightweight to preserve scroll performance.

If anything here is unclear or missing, tell me which section to expand and I’ll refine it.
